question.question:
A fund invests 6 USD million in a job-readiness programme and measures SROI over four years. Year 1 serves 5 thousand beneficiaries; each later year's active count is the prior year's count reduced by 10 percent. Each active beneficiary generates 3000 USD of outcome value per year. Deadweight of 10 percent of gross value is removed first. The quoted 70 percent attribution is the share of deadweight-adjusted value attributable to other_actors; if quoted for other_actors, the programme's share is the remainder. Net attributable value is deadweight-adjusted value times the programme's share. SROI equals net attributable value on the cumulative basis divided by the investment, both in USD millions: cumulative uses the four-year total, first_year uses year 1 only. Report the SROI ratio.

Answer format: return only the exact numeric value interpreted in `ratio`, using finite-decimal notation when it terminates in base 10 and an irreducible `numerator/denominator` fraction otherwise, with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Four-year total gross outcome value before deadweight and attribution, in USD millions
Fraction of deadweight-adjusted value credited to the programme after reading the quote
Year 1 net attributable value in USD millions
Four-year total net attributable value in USD millions
